# PQD-FH 01 — Final Quality Dossier (FQD) — Rev. 1.00

**Document issue date:** 13 October 2026  
**Author:** Arkadiusz Wójcik  
**Documentation license:** Creative Commons Attribution–ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)  
**Status:** Published procedure, Revision 1.00

## About this release

The first controlled publication of **PQD-FH 01 — Universal Final Quality Dossier Procedure**, part of the Progressive Quality Documentation & Final Handover Framework.

The procedure provides a structured approach for progressive collection, identification, verification and handover of project quality records and technical documentation. It is accompanied by editable procedure source files, a workbook for Appendices A–I and separate interactive PDF forms for Appendices A, D.1 and G.

## Usage and revision control

- Use the PDF procedure as the reference for reading and printing.
- The XLSX workbook and fillable PDFs are **Template Rev. 1.00**, compatible with **Procedure Rev. 1.00**.
- Adapt templates to the applicable contractual, project, inspection and approval requirements; manage completed forms as controlled project records.
- Identify the source revision when reusing or adapting documentation. Materials are licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, subject to the [license](https://github.com/arkadiuszwojcik-tech/PQD-FH/blob/main/LICENSE) and [licensing guide](https://github.com/arkadiuszwojcik-tech/PQD-FH/blob/main/LICENSING.md).
- The document issue date (13 October 2026) and the GitHub Release publication date are different events. Publishing the GitHub Release does not create a new procedure revision.

**Scope:** This release includes **PQD-FH 01 only**. Modules PQD-FH 02–06 are separate future publications. The UnitedQMS software initiative is not included in this documentation release.

**Official website:** https://unitedq.tech
